Major update with automation, risk controls, and new features:

- Added config.py for all settings and 14-indicator strategy logic (incl. ATR, MACD, VWAP, Bollinger, etc).
- Introduced price monitor with 1-second interval, auto SL/TP, breakeven, trailing, and delisting monitor.
- Implemented error_handling.py for self-healing and safety automation.
- New advanced_analysis.py for indicator scoring; scanner and monitor use dynamic ATR logic.
- Removed scripts/check_balance.py, scripts/check_positions.py, and deprecated single-file position-monitor.py in favor of modular, robust commands and cache.
- Documentation and SKILL.md overhauled: describes new features (auto-entry, cache, safety), risk configs, and enhanced file structure.

- Improved documentation with detailed setup instructions, usage, and example Telegram alerts.
- Expanded feature list, highlighting runner detection, Fibonacci+ATR-based SL/TP, and score-based signal ranking.
- Added configuration details and environment variable requirements.
- Emphasized safety warnings for futures trading.
- Clarified script purposes and alert templates for transparency.
Security fix: Removed hardcoded credentials, secure env loading

Neko Futures Trader 1.0.0 – Automated Binance Futures scanner and trading system.

- Scans 500+ USDT pairs for trade signals using runner detection (volume spike, momentum, breakout).
- Integrates real-time crypto news via Brave Search.
- Sets Fibonacci+ATR-based stop-loss and take-profit targets; monitors and auto-closes positions.
- Sends emoji-rich trade alerts, profit, and stop loss notifications to Telegram.
- Signals are score-ranked (0–10) and auto-trades are executed for qualifying signals.
- Easy setup with environment variables and detailed usage instructions.
